description.value: Emporia is a family-owned restaurant and live music venue in the heart of Langford on Vancouver Island's Westshore, serving elevated West Coast comfort food made almost entirely from locally sourced ingredients — farms in Metchosin, Sooke, Saanich, and Saltspring Island among them. The space offers cozy booths, a private lounge, and a south-facing patio, with craft BC beers, spirits, and regional wines on tap. As the evening progresses, a live stage hosts local bands, DJs, and open-mic nights.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name, phone, and address. Menu items are tagged 'VG' and 'GF' and OSM confirms diet:celiac=yes and diet:gluten_free=yes, supporting a vegetarian/GF amenity claim. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging, or takeout, so those remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: No mention of bike parking, bike rack, or secure bike storage anywhere on the website.
Water bottle refill and washroom availability not addressed on the website.
Takeout or to-go options not explicitly advertised, limiting utility for cyclists wanting a quick stop.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Emporia is a legitimate, active full-service restaurant well-suited to a meal stop for touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct inquiry is needed to verify these before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: South-facing patio and strong local-sourcing story make this an attractive listing if basic cycling amenities can be confirmed. Contact email is live@theemporia.ca (not in OSM).

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items labelled 'VG' (vegetarian) and 'GF' (gluten-free) — e.g. 'Mozzarella Arancini • VG GF' and 'Bocconcini Bruschetta • VG'

wow_evidence: family-owned restaurant and live music venue... locally sourced ingredients — farms in Metchosin, Sooke, Saanich, and Saltspring Island
